subject: SIG: secure SDLC evidence — CI/CD access logs, signed commits, and change approvals
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-audit.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodai.com
Cc: Security Assessments <soc2-requests@acme-audit.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: SIG questionnaire: request for SDLC/CI evidence

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of Acme's SIG review we need concrete evidence for your secure SDLC controls focused on CI/CD and change management. Specifically could you provide the following artifacts (or exact locations/exports):

- PR review policy and an export of recent PR review activity for the "inference-runtime" repo (last 90 days)
- A sample Buildkite/CI pipeline run log (successful + failed) and the pipeline definition used by prod builds
- Evidence of secrets scanning and ephemeral credential usage (scanner config + a run output)
- KMS key rotation policy and recent key rotation timestamp(s) for deployment keys
- Change approval ticket(s) that show peer review + manager approval for a production deployment (ticket ids preferred)
- Signed commit evidence (GPG/ssh) for releases in the last 30 days

If you can bundle these or point me to a Drive folder and attach any CSVs/logs, that would be ideal. Also call out where RBAC for CI agents is documented (service account permissions).

Happy to take things incrementally — we can start with the PR review export and one pipeline run.

Best,
Jordan
Security Assessments
Acme Financial

From: olga_petrov@redwoodai.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-audit.com>
Cc: Security Assessments <soc2-requests@acme-audit.com>, rachel_kim@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-22T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for SDLC/CI evidence

Jordan —

Thanks for the list. I've pulled together an evidence package and attached the files requested. Contents included in this message: ci-access-matrix-20261129.csv (service-account RBAC export), buildkite-pipeline-run-4287.log (example successful prod run), signed-commit-log-20261115.txt (GPG-signed commits for recent releases), and change-ticket-OPS-4821.pdf (the production rollout approval for the 2026-11-15 release).

Additional pointers:
- PR review exports: Drive folder (read-only) with reviewers.csv and pr-activity-90d.csv — link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example_CI_POLICY
- Secrets scanning: We run truffleHog and GitHub Advanced Security SAST; scanner config and last run tarball are in the Drive folder under /security/ci-scans/ (index file included in the Drive link).
- KMS: Key rotation schedule is documented in the KMS policy doc in the Drive folder; the most recent rotation for deploy-key-001 completed 2026-09-30.
- Pipeline definitions: All Buildkite YAML files live in the repo under .buildkite/ and the prod pipeline is linked here: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/pipelines/4287

I'll have Vivek attach the specific PR review CSV and show the signed-commit samples inline if you want snippets. If anything missing, tell me which exact formats you need (CSV vs JSON exports).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ci-access-matrix-20261129.csv, buildkite-pipeline-run-4287.log, signed-commit-log-20261115.txt, change-ticket-OPS-4821.pdf

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-audit.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodai.com
Cc: Security Assessments <soc2-requests@acme-audit.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:35:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for SDLC/CI evidence

Olga —

This is great, thanks for the quick turn. Two quick clarifications:

1) Can you confirm whether Buildkite artifact storage is encrypted at rest (we need the storage class + encryption details)?
2) For the signed commits file — can you include the output of `git verify-commit` or similar for 1–2 release commits so we can validate the signature chain?

Also, can you provide the exact service account principals that the pipeline agents run as (not just roles) so we can map permissions to your RBAC export? The ci-access-matrix CSV looks helpful but we need the full principals column.

If easier, Vivek can drop the small samples directly.

Regards,
Jordan

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-audit.com>, olga_petrov@redwoodai.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-25T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for SDLC/CI evidence — sample verification artifacts

Jordan / Olga —

Following up with the specific verification artifacts you asked for. Inline are shortened excerpts and pointers to full exports (Drive link in Olga's note).

1) Buildkite artifact encryption: we use GCS with CMEK (customer-managed encryption keys) via Cloud KMS. Artifacts stored in the bucket redwood-ci-artifacts-prod are encrypted with projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/deploy/cryptoKeys/artifacts-key. GCS bucket encryption settings and CMEK binding are in the Drive folder.

2) Signed commit verification (examples):
- commit: a3f9d2b (release/2026-11-15)
  gpg: Signature made Wed 15 Nov 2026 10:03:21 AM UTC
  gpg: Good signature from "Release Automation (redwood-release) <release@redwoodai.com>"
  Primary key ID: 0x9A3B7C12
  Verification command used: git verify-commit --raw a3f9d2b

3) Pipeline agent principals (sample rows added to ci-access-matrix-20261129.csv):
- serviceAccount:ci-agent@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com — roles: roles/cloudbuild.builds.builder, roles/storage.objectAdmin (limited to artifact bucket)
- serviceAccount:deploy-bot@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com — roles: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/kubernetes.admin (limited to deploy namespaces)

4) Secrets scanning / ephemeral creds: we use Vault dynamic secrets for DB credentials with TTL = 1h; scanner output and demo run are in the scan-run-20261114.tar.gz in Drive.

5) Change ticket reference: OPS-4821 is the formal approval packet for the 2026-11-15 prod rollout (attached PDF). That ticket shows code owner approvals + manager sign-off and the artifact checksum used for the release.

Quoted for context: "If you can bundle these or point me to a Drive folder and attach any CSVs/logs..." — Olga (Nov 22)

If you need the raw git verification outputs, I can paste them or upload a signed-verify-output.txt file.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior SRE — Buildkite/CI Ops
Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov@redwoodai.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-audit.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com, rachel_kim@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-29T15:43:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for SDLC/CI evidence — final items

Jordan —

Closing out the packet: I've added the service-account principals column to the ci-access-matrix-20261129.csv (attached) and uploaded the full git verify outputs to the Drive folder as signed-verify-output-20261125.txt. Drive link (same as above): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_example_CI_POLICY

Let me know if the auditors need anything formatted differently (PDF vs CSV) — happy to export.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov

Redwood Inference
